analyst.summary: Havells FY26/Q1FY27: cables the star (+20-27% YoY, capex-led), Lloyd AC volatile (Q3 FY26 -6.5%, Q4 FY26 -19% on delayed season, Q1 FY27 +14.6% on a decent-but-late summer), switchgear soft on cost-lag plus West Asia export disruption, ECD recovering. Q4 FY26's ~40% PAT beat was flattered by a Rs.283cr Goldi Solar fair-value one-off; Q1 FY27's 16.6% PAT decline is a deliberate, doubled A&P-spend margin trade to defend share vs Crompton/Voltas/Korean-Chinese AC brands, not a demand collapse. Valuation rich (~40x PE) versus core growth actually delivered. Hold.
